title: 第七章 镜与铜人第八章 沙发下的干尸
slug: 盗三界第五百六十章黑影
lines: 细碎的声音在许源耳边响起。
却见黑影避无可避，突然穿过那团烈焰，身形一闪，直接出现在走廊的另一侧。
它甚至还伸手在虚空中轻轻一按。
——自己已经尽了全力，但那黑影会瞬移！
见鬼，它还能直接穿过烈焰！
它轻描淡写地摁灭了自己全力施展的两招！
这是当下唯一的逃生策略！
许源正想着，忽见眼角余光中，再次浮现出那道黑影——
许源心头一沉，蓦然停住脚步。
这怪物虚无缥缈，实力又极其恐怖。
但它却似乎没有什么战意。
许源以短刀护在胸前，沉声问。
“——如果你凭这句话能找到我，我会给你一个满意的答案。”黑影悬浮在走廊上，优哉游哉地说。
你如果不在这里，我又是在跟谁战斗？
许源冷笑着正要接话，忽然想到了什么，不由浑身一颤。
content_en:
;;
"It's useless."
A thin voice sounded in Xu Yuan's ears.
But he saw that the black shadow could not be avoided, and suddenly passed through the flames, and appeared directly on the other side of the corridor in a flash.
It even reached out and touched the void lightly.
The sword energy and the pill fire were extinguished together.
Take advantage of the other party to take action——
Xu Yuan turned around and ran outside.
——I have tried my best, but the black shadow will teleport!
Heck, it can also pass right through the flames!
It easily suppressed the two moves it had used with all its strength!
What's wrong with this?
——It’s completely beyond imagination!
At the end of the corridor is the window.
Crash it.
Jump directly to the third floor.
This is the only escape strategy at the moment!
Xu Yuan was just thinking when he suddenly saw the dark shadow appearing again in the corner of his eye——
"You exceeded my highest expectations."
The shadow praised.
Xu Yuan's heart sank and he suddenly stopped.
It comes so fast.
This monster is ethereal and extremely powerful.
Not something a high school student can handle.
But it seems to have no fighting spirit.
It seems...
Are you testing yourself?
"What are you? What do you want to do?"
Xu Yuan protected his chest with a short knife and asked in a deep voice.
"A little tip."
"I'm actually not in this hospital."
"——If you can find me with this sentence, I will give you a satisfactory answer." The black shadow said leisurely as it floated in the corridor.
Not here...
How is it possible.
If you weren't here, who would I be fighting with?
It’s so mysterious!
Xu Yuan sneered and was about to answer when he suddenly thought of something and couldn't help but tremble.
"impossible……"
